contract: pgos1 object envelope (core-back/lib/objectStorageSdk/crypto.ts:169-221): magic 'pgos1' | frames u32be(plaintextLen) | ciphertext(plaintextLen) | tag(16) to EOF; chunk nonce = prefix[0..7] | u32be(index) | u8(final); AAD = uuidBytes(objectId)[16] | u32be(index) | u8(final); DEK 32 random bytes wrapped AES-256-GCM under KEK vN with nonce12 and AAD 'dek:<objectId>:v<N>', stored as ct(32) | tag(16). metadata uses the pg-objstore ObjectCryptoMetadata field names (snake_case).
notes: streams contain a random DEK, 7-byte nonce prefix and wrapped-DEK nonce by construction; the generator reuses the committed stream after proving it decrypts. --refresh-random mints new ones.
frameLengths lists the u32be value of every frame in order: the plaintext length of that chunk (16-byte GCM tag is not included).
